title.zh: 删除直播录制转点播配置

descriptions.zh:
先获取主播流域名，再调用本接口删除直播录制转点播配置。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to delete the live-to-VOD configuration for a specified streaming domain.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-record-vod-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveRecordVodConfig --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
